summary: Strengths are free shipping stated in the header on every page, a real founder story with a quality promise, and a footer email sign-up. The gaps are missing policy pages and footer links (the /policies/ URLs return 404), inconsistent shipping and returns details, and no reviews or back-in-stock option; much of this is deliberate demo content.
strengths: A "Free shipping available on all orders!" bar shows at screen 1 on all 5 product pages checked
The About page names a founder, a start year (2015) and a "quality promise" with a take-back line
A contact page with phone, email, address and a contact form exists; a Returns page states a 14-day window and condition rules
Footer has an email sign-up and social links; none of 14 pages triggered a pop-up on phone

findings.title: The footer links to "Shipping policy" but has no link to returns, privacy or terms, and the standard /policies/ pages return 404
see_it: Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/ and scroll to the footer: links are Bags, Shoes, Lookbook, About, Contact us, Shipping policy, Blog
Look for Returns, Refund, Privacy or Terms: none appear
Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/policies/refund-policy, /policies/privacy-policy, /policies/terms-of-service and /policies/shipping-policy: each shows a 404 page

evidence.note: links list: footer has Contact us, Shipping policy (to /pages/shipping), Blog; no returns, privacy or terms link

findings.why_it_matters: A shopper checking returns or privacy before buying cannot find them from any page. The returns text exists at /pages/returns but nothing in the footer or menu points to it, so it is reachable only by typing the address. Hesitant first-time buyers are the ones who look for this. Worth checking with whoever owns compliance whether the privacy and terms texts should be published.

fix.summary: Fill in the four store policies in Shopify admin and add footer links to Returns, Privacy and Terms.
steps: Settings > Policies: add refund, shipping, privacy and terms texts (or use the generator)
Online Store > Navigation > Footer menu: add Returns, Privacy policy, Terms of service
Point the 'Shipping policy' link to the same text the checkout shows
fix.where_to_change: Settings > Policies and Online Store > Navigation

findings.claude_prompt: For https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com the footer has no link to returns, privacy or terms and /policies/* returns 404. Draft clear refund, shipping, privacy and terms texts for me to review with the owner (I will confirm the real terms), and list the exact footer menu changes. Work on a duplicate or unpublished theme, never edit checkout, keep the existing design system, and show the diff before publishing. Check by opening each policy URL and the footer on phone.
findings.verify_fix: Open the footer on phone: Returns, Privacy and Terms links are present and each opens a filled-in page; /policies/refund-policy no longer shows 404.

findings.title: The returns page gives a 14-day window but does not say who pays return shipping or how to start a return, while another page says returns are free
see_it: Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/pages/returns: it says items can be returned "within 14 days of receiving it", unused, with tags, in original packaging
Look for who pays postage, a returns address or steps to start a return: none
Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/pages/shipping-returns: it says "Free shipping and returns available on all orders!"

evidence.note: 14-day window, condition rules, processing time 5 to 7 business days; no cost or how-to-start
"Free shipping and returns available on all orders!"
broken link on /pages/returns to dawn-theme-default.myshopify.com/shopify.com (404), likely a leftover template link

findings.why_it_matters: A buyer cannot tell if returning costs them money or what to do next, and two pages give different levels of detail. This raises pre-purchase doubt and support questions. No returns or guarantee line appears near Add to cart on any of the 5 product pages checked (keyPositions.returns is empty on all 5), so the reassurance is not where the decision is made.

fix.summary: Merge the two pages into one returns policy that states window, who pays postage, how to start, and link it from product pages.
steps: State who pays return shipping and how to start a return (email or form)
Remove the duplicate /pages/shipping-returns or make it match
Add a one-line returns note under Add to cart on the product template
Remove or fix the broken link on /pages/returns
fix.where_to_change: Online Store > Pages, and Themes > Customize > Product page

findings.claude_prompt: On https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/pages/returns the policy lacks who pays return shipping and how to start a return, and /pages/shipping-returns says returns are free. Draft one consistent returns text from facts I provide, and a short 'Free 14-day returns' line for the product page under Add to cart. Work on a duplicate or unpublished theme, never edit checkout, keep the existing design system, and show the diff before publishing.
findings.verify_fix: Returns pages agree, state cost and steps, and a returns line shows under Add to cart on phone.

findings.title: Shipping times differ between pages: "2-4 business days" worldwide on one, "US domestic orders within 5-10 business days" on another
see_it: Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/pages/shipping: "We ship worldwide ... Delivery takes between 2-4 business days"
Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/pages/shipping-returns: "We ship all US domestic orders within 5-10 business days"

evidence.note: worldwide, 2-4 business days, free on all orders

findings.why_it_matters: A shopper reading both gets two delivery promises, which causes doubt before buying and "where is my order" contacts after. The footer 'Shipping policy' link opens only the first page. This looks like leftover template text on a demo store, so treat it as deliberate placeholder content, but a real store would need one source of truth.

fix.summary: Keep one shipping page with real times per region and delete or redirect the other.
steps: Decide the real delivery times by region

findings.claude_prompt: On https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com two pages give different delivery times (2-4 vs 5-10 business days). Help me write one shipping page with a table by region from times I confirm, and a redirect from the old page. Work on a duplicate or unpublished theme, never edit checkout, keep the existing design system, and show the diff before publishing.
findings.verify_fix: Only one shipping page exists and its times match checkout.

findings.title: None of the 5 product pages checked shows a star rating, review count or customer review
see_it: Open https://theme-dawn-demo.myshopify.com/products/helix-denim on a phone and scroll the whole page (about 5 screens)
Look near the price and below the description for stars or reviews: none

evidence.note: keyPositions.reviews is null; product.rating and reviewCount are null
apps: [] so no review app detected

findings.why_it_matters: Items cost 119 to 615 CAD (median 460), so buyers weigh the purchase. With no ratings on the page and none in structured data, shoppers have no outside voice and Google cannot show stars in results. The only proof on the site are two quotes on the home page. The product pages also say "This is a demonstration store", so the absence may be deliberate for a demo.

fix.summary: Add a reviews app or section and show the rating beside the price.
steps: Install a review tool and send review requests after delivery
Show rating and count under the product title
Make sure rating appears in product structured data
fix.where_to_change: Shopify App Store, then Themes > Customize > Product page
